node_purpose: Six responsible authors amend only reviewed Dell papers, then a Writer produces the complete Chinese case report and an independent Verifier assesses it. This is a source-bound report handoff, not automatic product acceptance.
input_scale_basis: Ten archived papers across nine topics; six targeted public-feedback revisions, each own fresh native context. Writer and Verifier read current papers and original sources on demand. No whole research rerun or sibling private reasoning.
required_outputs: Six responsible source-bound paper revisions with finding dispositions
One integrated Chinese report with source-resolvable inline claim citations
Independent final report review with material/unresolved findings preserved
schema_burden: Six native author nodes in pairs, then native Writer/Verifier; each has MCP tools plus a domain submission. Only citation/schema/authority mechanics enforced locally; free report prose judged semantically by the reviewer.
materiality_quality_risk: Original reports and review failures remain immutable. Prior reviewers missed orders-vs-usage, so explicit host-assisted feedback is disclosed. Numeric non-S2 remains non-authoritative; no Evidence admission, SQL writes, release or product PASS.
comparable_run_evidence: A1 full-case review24calls/1567290tokens/1.9244712CNY/473.5s; native loop, source tools, two fresh SDK PG-state readers proven. New130nearby tests plus six final local checks, actual A1 feedback, independent author checkpoints and needs-revision outcome tested.
reasoning_profile: Two independent Pro/low thinking-enabled native create_agent message loops, each persisted by Agent Server; never transfer private reasoning between them. No model fallback or automatic transport retry.
cost_and_latency_estimate: Estimated3–7CNY for this bounded convergence, not a guaranteed invoice; six authors often3–8turns, parallel2 then writer/reviewer, likely10–30minutes. No silent scope deletion to save cost; stop unknown/truncated outcomes, no automatic retry/fallback.

repair.node_purpose: Responsible author revises one original paper from exact independent/human feedback, preserving unaffected claims and rechecking sources rather than adopting reviewer opinions.
repair.input_scale: One4–20k-character workpaper, exact findings, source catalog; typically3–8turns with on-demand windows.12model/32tool capacity; no sibling notebooks or hidden reasoning.
required_outputs: Only changed source-bound claims and removals
Disposition of each review finding and unresolved gaps
repair.schema_burden: Native read-only MCP tools plus one source-bound domain submission. Free Chinese report uses exact paper:claim links, not a fixed prose schema. Local errors returned together.
repair.materiality_quality_risk: Do not equate source binding with semantic truth; distinguish period/company/unit, non-S2, demand proxy vs usage, regional aggregate and volume shipment. Report material unresolved issues honestly.
repair.comparable_run_evidence: A1 case Counter14/Verifier10calls,total1567290tokens/1.9244712CNY/473.5swall. It found genuine issues but missed demand-vs-usage; explicit host feedback added, no blind evaluation claim. Preserve original papers.
